name: code-review-suite
description: Reliable C/C++ static analysis with optional independent multi-round AI review.

interface.shortDescription: C/C++ static and optional AI review.
interface.longDescription: Run Cppcheck, Flawfinder, and Splint over a shared filtered source manifest, optionally add an independent multi-round AI reviewer, validate exact AI evidence, preserve run history, and generate full offline HTML, Markdown, and JSON reports.
defaultPrompt: Run Code Analyzer on this C/C++ project.
Aggregate and triage Cppcheck, Flawfinder, and Splint findings and diagnostics.
Enable multi-round AI review only when explicitly requested.
Create a full offline static-analysis dashboard after every scan.
